title: AMD AI Solutions | AI Infrastructure
full_text: AMD AI Solutions | AI Infrastructure Skip to main content AMD Website Accessibility Statement Confidently Build Your AI Business Outcomes AI Solutions Start with AMD AI is reshaping every business function. AMD helps you move from ambition to outcomes with a trusted, open, and flexible compute foundation built for real-world AI. The Challenge Ahead AI Is Essential. The Path Is Complex. AI expectations are rising fast – and the pressure is specific: commit to an AI strategy that is ambitious, credible, and future-ready, while managing unknown costs, governance requirements, sustainability limits, and infrastructure maturity gaps. As AI agents take on more autonomous roles across your business, your infrastructure must handle concurrent, multi-model workloads at speed without spiraling budgets. AMD helps leaders solve the key challenges to AI adoption and optimization. Will this platform scale as AI evolves? How do we avoid lock-in? Can we manage cost, power, and complexity? How do we move from pilots to production? Why AMD Build AI That Performs at Scale – Without the Trade-Offs Broadest Portfolio – Agentic AI Ready Run Every AI Workload on the Right Engine Run AI on the right engine with AMD EPYC server CPUs, AMD Instinct GPUs, AMD RyzenAI processors, adaptive computing , networking , ROCm software , and full-stack solutions. AMD is optimized for efficient inference scaling, agentic workflow framing, and real-world deployment – the workloads enterprises actually run at scale, not just frontier model training. No Vendor Lock-In Open by Design Build with more choice through open software , standards-based development , leading frameworks, cloud providers, OEMs, ISVs , and ecosystem partners. Avoid the cost and complexity of proprietary-only stacks—AMD is built on open standards so your infrastructure stays adaptable as AI evolves. An ecosystem that evolves with you, not around you. Leadership Performance and Cost More AI for Every Watt – and Every Dollar AMD Instinct accelerators deliver industry-leading performance-per-watt, giving you more tokens per dollar and a lower TCO across your AI infrastructure. Scale AI without hitting power or budget walls—high performance with low environmental impact. Deployment Options Powering AI Everywhere From cloud to data center to edge and AI PCs, AMD helps you build AI where it makes the most sense for your business. abstract image Cloud AI Meet Demand, Maximize Resources Choose AMD-based virtual machines (VMs) to achieve performance and OPEX advantages in your preferred cloud. Cloud Computing abstract image Data Center AI Solve the Biggest Challenges Solve for existing tech debt, manage data readiness, security, and compliance, and find the right-sized solution for your specific data center needs. Data Center abstract image Regulated and Sovereign AI Build for Resilience Build governed AI capabilities to support data control, ecosystem resilience, governance, resilience, and jurisdictional requirements. Sovereign AI abstract image Hybrid AI On-Prem+Cloud Flexible architectures that help organizations deploy AI across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments while preserving portability and control. abstract image Edge and Embedded AI Deliver Performance at the Edge Adaptive and embedded compute that brings AI closer to data, decisions, and devices. AI Edge abstract image AI PCs and Workstations Agent Computers: Delegate, Don’t Just Operate Local AI experiences with responsive performance to support the on-device agentic AI tasks your workforce needs – without sending sensitive data to the cloud. Business Systems Get Started Stay Ready as AI Evolves AI will keep changing. AMD helps you stay ready with open, flexible, efficient infrastructure designed to evolve with new models, workloads, and business needs. Free eBook Download A Practical Guide for IT Leaders: Modern Infrastructure for the AI Era Modernize AI infrastructure with AMD: build open, scalable, energy-efficient platforms that accelerate business outcomes from data center to edge. Learn more in this eBook for IT leaders. Get Guide Free Ebook Download The AI Ready Enterprise Learn how enterprises modernize IT infrastructure for AI, overcome adoption obstacles, and build scalable, efficient foundations with AMD. Get Guide Customer Success Stories You’re Not Advancing AI Alone See How AMD Helps Customers Move Forward < Meta"/> Meta and AMD Advancing AI Infrastructure Through Deep Engineering Collaboration AMD and Meta have built one of the industry's deepest AI infrastructure engineering partnerships, collaborating across silicon, systems, networking, software and open AI infrastructure. Learn More < OpenAI"/> AMD and OpenAl: Collaborating Across Every Layer of the Stack At Advancing Al, AMD and OpenAI demonstrated that their strategic partnership is advancing from roadmap alignment to technical execution. Learn More AT&T Achieves Outstanding Efficiency for AI Training with AMD AT&T trains telecom AI on AMD Instinct™ MI355X GPUs, running a full model on a single GPU to power inference for millions of customers. View Case Study Cisco and AMD Advance AI-Driven Healthcare Healthcare systems modernize IT infrastructure for AI-ready, digitally resilient operations with Cisco servers advanced by AMD EPYC™ Server CPUs. View Case Study Hitachi Modernizes Global Employee Computing with AMD PRO Hitachi projects significant cost savings and scales its global Device-as-a-Service infrastructure using AMD Ryzen™ PRO processors. View Case Study TensorWave: Reliable, Resilient, Cost-Optimized AI Cloud TensorWave built an AMD Instinct™ GPU cloud delivering reliable, resilient AI infrastructure with up to 2x performance and 40–60% cost savings vs. alternatives. View Case Study "> See More Stories Resources Explore AMD Tools and Expertise for Your AI Journey Developer Central Access development platforms, SDKs, libraries, tools, frameworks, technical docs, and more. Learn More AI Developer Program Access cloud credits, premium training, and a community of developers building the future of AI on AMD hardware. Learn More AMD Silo AI See how AMD helps customers develop and deploy advanced AI solutions for leadership compute platforms. Learn More Latest Blogs Browse the latest in thought leadership and technical expertise from AMD. View Blogs Feedback AMD.com Feedback Privacy Policy.
